quote.text: It is not the events but our viewpoint toward events that is the determining factor. We ought to be more concerned about removing wrong thoughts from the mind than removing tumors and abscesses from the body.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that the mindset you nurture in your children is as important as the lessons you teach—they, too, can learn to see everyday struggles as opportunities for growth.
    • By encouraging reflection over reaction, you instill in them the wisdom to distinguish between the external events of life and the internal narratives they choose to embrace.
  • Leadership
    • Cultivate a perspective in your team that shifts focus from the obstacles you face to the values you espouse—this leads to a more resilient and unified working environment.
    • As a leader, prioritize the reform of misguided thoughts by modeling calm and thoughtful responses, thereby inspiring a collective strength that transforms challenges into possibilities.
  • Product Management
    • Embrace the idea that setbacks in product development are not failures but signals to re-examine and refine your approach—your viewpoint can pivot potential obstacles into innovative breakthroughs.
    • Foster a culture where feedback and criticisms are met with curious inquiry rather than despair, transforming every challenge into an opportunity for a reflective and strategic evolution.
